expectedBehavior: A profile-selected Mac HelloIos build reaches the active-stack Mono AOT compiler and native link, retaining a private binlog for offline verification.
observedBehavior: The explicit SDK 10.0.402 Mac capture completed HelloIos for net10.0-ios/ios-arm64/Release with exit code 0. Sidecar hashes verified. The private binlog records mono-aot-cross compilation of HelloIos.dll for arm64-ios, generated assembly/object/AOT-data outputs, an executed clang++ native-link command containing the AOT objects, and linker output. AotProbe also built successfully, but only as a managed class library and therefore provides no AOT or device-execution evidence.
limitations: The captured worktree was dirty and no global.json governed SDK selection, so this capture is not a canonical reproducible source snapshot.
The final .app, Mach-O inspection, and independent codesign verification were not retained with the private capture.
This is Mac reference evidence only; it does not prove the Linux-hosted compiler, Linux workload-manifest strategy, device installation, or device execution.
Raw reports and binlogs contain sensitive operational metadata and remain ignored, owner-private artifacts.
nextDecision: Preserve the Mac reference result as an AOT/native-link baseline, then continue M0/M1 with the disposable Linux workload-manifest graph and Linux compiler feasibility. Capture final-app architecture and signature verification separately before any signing or deployment claim.

commands.command: SHA-256 verify all supplied private report, inventory, and binlog sidecars from the new HelloIos and AotProbe captures.
Offline-decompress and inspect the private HelloIos binary log for AOT compiler output, target options, native-link command, and linker output; do not export the decoded log.

excluded: signing identities, profile selectors, profile identifiers, and entitlement metadata
raw binlogs, project imports, environment records, and diagnostic output
Apple SDK assets, credentials, and device records
